contact.full_name: SENIOR ASSOCIATE – FUND ADMINISTRATION | MIDDLE OFFICE | TRADE SUPPORT

data.summary:
Finance professional with 3+ years of experience across investment operations, middle office, and
derivatives trade support at global banks and fund administrators. Strong expertise in OTC derivatives,
prime brokerage, NAV support, T+1 settlements, and end-to-end trade lifecycle management. Proven
ability to analyze and resolve complex trade, cash, and position breaks, reduce operational risk, and
drive automation-led efficiency improvements. Actively upskilling in Python, SQL, and Power BI to
transition into data-driven investment operations and risk analytics roles.

SUMMARY
